targets.old_statement: A first-time license issued to someone under age 65 lasts eight years and expires on the holder's birthday.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A first-time license issued to someone under age sixty-five lasts eight years and expires on the holder's birthday.
targets.statement: A Nevada license or ID expires on the holder's birthday in the fourth or eighth year depending on age, unless limited-term immigration documents set expiration to the DHS-verified departure date or one year if unspecified.
